==Biography==
===2017 Season===
YaGao started playing professionally for the amateur team [[Moss Seven Club]]. He and the team placed third during [[Tencent Games Arena Hero of Cities/Season 12|TGA Hero of Cities Season 12]], earning a spot in the [[LSPL/2017 Season/Summer Season|2017 LSPL Summer Season]]. The team finished the split with a 7-15 match record, ranking close to the bottom of the standings. At the end of the season, YaGao left the team and joined [[JD Gaming]] as their starting mid laner.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''YaGao''' (牙膏) means "Toothpaste" in Chinese.
** His original ID on the Chinese server is '''黑人牙膏''', the old Chinese name of the [[wikipedia:en:Darlie|Darlie toothpaste brand]].
* Good friends with [[Knight (Zhuo Ding)|Knight]]. They are from the same city and met in an internet cafe before they became professional players.
* Broke the LPL record for percent damage to champions with {{ci|Zoe}} on Jan 29, 2018. He did 57.9% of his team's total damage to champions.
** This stats got surpassed by [[huanfeng]]'s Jinx in 2021 Spring Playoffs with a 66.2%.
* Considered to be the best {{ci|Zoe}} and {{ci|Azir}} player in China.
* Infamously known for his {{ci|ryze}}, holding an extremely low win-rate with this champion. Also known for a 8-game losing streak with {{ci|ryze}} in 2019 season.
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 Kills in the LPL in February 26, 2021.
** The 25th player to reach 1000 Kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on August 07, 2022.
** The 17th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on March 07, 2024.
** The 11th player to reach 2000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on February 04, 2023.
** Was the 18th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on March 16, 2024.
** The 13th player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL, after [[meiko]], [[Pyl (Chen Bo)|Pyl]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[cold]], [[Doinb]], [[Crisp]], [[LvMao]], [[Missing]], [[Scout]], and [[Flandre]].
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on February 22, 2023
** The 16th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on February 4, 2024
** The 10th player to reach 600 games in the LPL after [[Rookie]], [[meiko]], [[xiaohu]], [[Flandre]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[Lwx]], and [[Crisp]].
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on February 27, 2023.
** Was the 14th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL after [[Clearlove]], [[meiko]], [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], [[Flandre]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiye]], [[Lwx]], [[JackeyLove]], and [[Crisp]].
* Reached 400 wins in the LPL on June 07, 2024.
** Was the 7th player to reach 400 wins in the LPL after [[meiko]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], and [[JackeyLove]].
